scopes.note: Observed on /problem/P1001#submit. The combo is the only visible .combo-wrapper.lang-select.

The #ide tab was not captured in the read-only reconnaissance. The same selectors are used only when exactly one visible combo resolves; otherwise language sync degrades to unsupported/read-only with an explicit reason.

notes: The language widget is not a native select. Clicking .text opens a document-level .dropdown (inside .lfe-body) whose li labels are authoritative.
Option identity is the exact normalized li text. Numeric Luogu language ids are deliberately ignored.
C++14 and C++14 (GCC 9) both map to the c++14 standard, so a standard-level choice must ask the user which option to use.
If more than one visible combo resolves, the adapter returns an unsupported reason instead of guessing.
